name: Invoices
description: Preview, regenerate, approve and correct invoices.
takeaways: Saving an active contract regenerates draft and upcoming invoices
Approval can be blocked by a tax change

cards.title: Draft to approved
cards.body: Invoices start as drafts. Approving one makes it outstanding; it then becomes partially paid, paid, or overdue. The invoice list has tabs for All, Draft, Outstanding and Overdue.
cards.example: An invoice due Mar 31 turns Overdue on Apr 1 if unpaid.

cards.title: Approval and tax check
cards.body: On V3 approval Zenskar re-verifies tax. A material tax change beyond the organization policy keeps the invoice in draft and returns 409.
cards.example: Tax rate changed overnight, so approval is held.

cards.title: Bulk actions
cards.body: Select invoices in the list to approve, or approve and charge, as a background job.
cards.example: Approve and charge all April drafts.

cards.title: Invoice Preview
cards.body: On the contract Summary tab, switch on Invoice Preview to see the invoices the current settings would produce. It needs a customer, currency, duration and at least one line item.
cards.example: Change a price and watch next month's invoice update.

cards.title: Invoices tab
cards.body: Only an active contract has one. It lists each invoice with billing period, status, total and amount due.
cards.example: 12 monthly invoices of a yearly contract.

cards.title: Regenerate invoices
cards.body: Recalculates draft and upcoming invoices. Saving an active contract starts it automatically; you can also start it after a failed run.
cards.example: Amend a price, save, and upcoming invoices update.

cards.title: Invoice date
cards.body: Set by the organization-wide invoice date rule. A single draft invoice can be edited manually. See the Dates module.
cards.example: Bill For Date Mar 1, +1 month, last day: Apr 30.

cards.title: Credit notes
cards.body: A credit note is created against an invoice and has its own line items. Credit notes created in Stripe are imported but Zenskar does not push them.
cards.example: Credit $100 on an invoice for a service outage.

cards.title: Void
cards.body: An invoice can be voided through the API or product.

edgeCases: Invoices tab. Only an active contract has one.
One run at a time. Only one regeneration runs per contract; a second request follows the run in progress.
Scope of regeneration. It recalculates draft and upcoming invoices.
Permissions. Preview needs Can Read Contract and Can Read Invoice; regeneration needs Can Update Contract.
Held approval. A material tax change beyond policy leaves the invoice in draft with a 409.
Imported invoices. Invoices imported from an external system cannot be charged from Zenskar.
Draft only. Manual invoice date edits apply to draft invoices.

quiz.question: What must a contract have before Invoice Preview works?
options: Customer, currency, duration and at least one line item
quiz.explanation: Those four are the documented prerequisites.

quiz.question: What does saving an active contract trigger?
options: Invoice regeneration for draft and upcoming invoices

quiz.question: Two regeneration requests arrive together. What happens?
options: The second follows the run in progress
quiz.explanation: Only one regeneration runs for a contract at a time.

quiz.question: At V3 approval, a material tax change exceeds policy. Result?
quiz.explanation: The approval-time tax check holds it.

quiz.question: Which invoices can Charge Invoice apply to?
options: Approved or partially paid, not imported ones
quiz.explanation: Imported invoices cannot be charged from Zenskar.

qa.question: Draft vs approved invoice?
qa.answer: Draft can be edited and regenerated. Approving makes it outstanding.

qa.question: Preview vs generate vs regenerate?
qa.answer: Preview shows what a contract would produce. Generate creates an invoice for a customer, contract and date range. Regenerate recalculates draft and upcoming invoices.

qa.question: Approve vs approve V3?
qa.answer: V3 approval re-verifies tax, and a material change beyond policy keeps the invoice in draft with a 409.

qa.question: Charge Invoice vs payment link?
qa.answer: Charge collects using a saved payment method. A link lets the customer pay online, optionally in part.

qa.question: Credit note vs void?
qa.answer: A credit note offsets an invoice amount. Void cancels the invoice. Use the credit note when the invoice should stand.

qa.question: Native vs imported invoices?
qa.answer: Imported invoices come from an external system and cannot be charged from Zenskar.

qa.question: Consolidated invoice vs parent and child billing?
qa.answer: Consolidation merges existing invoices into one document; parent and child routes billing to the parent.

qa.question: Invoice date vs due date?
qa.answer: Invoice date comes from the date rule; due date from payment terms.

qa.question: Price was wrong mid-cycle?
qa.answer: Amend the contract and let draft and upcoming invoices regenerate.

qa.question: Approve all drafts at month end?
qa.answer: Select them in the list and approve, or approve and charge, as a bulk job.

qa.question: Compensate a service outage?
qa.answer: Create a credit note against the invoice.

qa.question: See next quarter's invoices before signing?
qa.answer: Turn on Invoice Preview on the contract.

qa.question: Avoid duplicate invoices for a period?
qa.answer: Set check_duplicate_invoice when generating or approving.

qa.question: Approve without emailing the customer?
qa.answer: Pass send_email=false on approve.

qa.question: Why is there no Invoices tab?
qa.answer: Only active contracts have one.

qa.question: Two regenerations started together?
qa.answer: Only one runs at a time; the second follows the run in progress.

qa.question: Are approved invoices recalculated?
qa.answer: Regeneration recalculates draft and upcoming invoices.

qa.question: Why does preview return nothing?
qa.answer: It needs a customer, currency, duration and at least one line item, and the Can Read Contract and Can Read Invoice permissions.

qa.question: Tax changed overnight?
qa.answer: On V3 approval a material change beyond policy leaves the invoice in draft (409).

qa.question: What does generate_invoice need?
qa.answer: customer_id, contract_id, from_date and to_date; optionally check_duplicate_invoice and bill_for_date.

qa.question: What tabs does the invoice list have?
qa.answer: All, Draft, Outstanding and Overdue.

qa.question: How are payments linked to invoices?
qa.answer: A payment lists the invoices it applies to and the amount per invoice.
